14:46 < MouseLRN> did you see linux-vr project?
14:47 < jal0> the problem people dont understand is that pda's are not like desktops, with the desktop system, the hardware interfaces have , to some extent, been standarized. This is not the case with PDA's, almost everything is different in hardware. So even all the drivers must be re-written.
14:49 < jal0> porting linux to a pda is not like installing linux on desktop systems. alot of code has to be customized. what make this hard is that there is practically NO documentation.
14:51 < PsycoXul> hey at least you got a kernel to start with
14:51 < PsycoXul> the rockbox project for archos mp3 players had to write everything from scratch :p
14:51 < MouseLRN> bye 2 all, I'll have exam tomorrow.
